## How this work is cited

Passages inside The Sovereignty of Good are identified by chapter and essay. Three essays first published separately between 1956 and 1969 and collected in 1970, so the chapter and the original essay are two different locators for the same text.

## The work in Iris Murdoch’s thought

Iris Murdoch (1919–1999) was an Irish-British philosopher and novelist who revived moral attention to the good against mid-century linguistic narrowness. A student at Oxford and briefly influenced by Sartre, she turned toward Plato. [More on Iris Murdoch](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/iris-murdoch) .
